Adds the `RemovePodGroup` method to the `SchedulerSimulator` interface and its implementations.
This is a preparatory change for WAS deep integration ([#16483](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/16483)) to unregister virtual PodGroups from the simulation snapshot.
Related to [#14201](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/14201)

## AI summary

Added `RemovePodGroup` to `SchedulerSimulator`. The WAS simulator removes the PodGroup from its snapshot, and the DRA checker forwards the call. This supports reusing a snapshot across partial-admission planning attempts.

### Suggested release note

`NONE` — this adds simulator behavior for internal scheduling integration and does not establish a user-facing behavior change.

### Comment by [@alien1403](https://github.com/alien1403) — 2026-10-19T10:27:43Z

> I'm not opposed - but where exactly will this be used? Do we **have** to remove the PG of the current workload or is this for cleanliness?

We need it for partial admission https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/blob/4e915f63372a80973086855f00c7e13719a2aa85/pkg/scheduler/scheduler.go#L1583, where we call `Plan()` multiple times on the same snapshot when reducing counts

If we don't clean it up, the next `AddPodGroup` fails with already exists in snapshot

LMK WDYK cc: @olekzabl @kshalot @mimowo

### Comment by [@olekzabl](https://github.com/olekzabl) — 2026-10-19T11:47:57Z

> > I'm not opposed - but where exactly will this be used? Do we **have** to remove the PG of the current workload or is this for cleanliness?

> If we don't clean it up, the next `AddPodGroup` fails with already exists in snapshot
> 
> LMK WDYK cc: @olekzabl @kshalot @mimowo

I support this.

Theoretically we could live without `RemovePodGroup` by differentiating the virtual PodGroups per every attempt (e.g. `my-workload-attempt-1`, `my-workload-attempt-2` etc.).
But I think given a choice between such hacks and properly cleaning PodGroups, the latter wins with its conceptual clarity.
